name: export_carousel_pages
description: Export a carousel as web pages. Writes one still HTML page per slide (slide-01.html ...), plain HTML and CSS with no scripts, and index.html, one page that swipes through all of them, into a new folder. The images a slide uses are copied beside the pages (assets/) with relative paths, so the folder opens anywhere. Fonts load from Google Fonts the first time the pages open. With list true, writes nothing and lists the slides. The pages go in a new folder inside out (slides, then slides 2, ...); nothing already there is changed.

input.description: No file input: operates on a carousel project (see the project param).

output.description: {dir, pages: [slide-NN.html ...], index, files: [paths relative to dir], warnings: [...]}; with list: {items: [{index, id}]}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: out
params.description: The folder to put the pages' new folder in (required unless list is true). Outside the workspace it must be an existing folder that is not hidden and not a system or app folder.

params.name: slides
params.description: Only these slides, as a comma-separated list of slide numbers from 1 (default: all)

params.name: list
params.description: List the slides and write nothing
